entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something.
I can certainly look into that for you. May I have your name and the order number, please?
Alex Miller. The order is VF98765.

Thank you, Alex. I see you purchased the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To make sure I'm helping correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It works. I just don't like it. I want to send it back.
I understand. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it was delivered on December 15th, which was 18 days ago.
Well, Alex, according to our return policy for electronic wearables like the VeloBand Pulse, the window for a full refund is 10 days from the date of delivery.

Yes, it's a specific policy for this device. I'm afraid at 18 days, it's too late to process a return for a refund. The policy is this strict because once the device is activated and worn, we can't resell it.
So I'm just supposed to eat the cost? That's ridiculous.

I do apologize for the frustration. The reason behind the policy is rooted in hygiene and user safety. After this much time, for sanitation reasons, we are unable to accept wearable electronics back into our inventory. It's a bio-contaminant risk.
Right. 'Sanitation'. I barely wore it. Whatever.

I understand it's not the answer you were hoping for. While I can't process a return, many of our customers who find themselves in a similar situation have had success selling their device on the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace online. You can often recoup most of the cost there.
Great. So I get to do the work myself. Fantastic customer service.
I'm sorry you feel that way, Alex. Unfortunately, my hands are tied by the return policy on this matter. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
